usage: 炒河粉 is a noun used to refer to a popular Cantonese dish made from stir-fried rice noodles.
You can use 炒河粉 as the subject or object in a sentence, for example, '我想食炒河粉' (I want to eat stir-fried ho fun).
炒河粉 is often used in menus or when ordering food in restaurants.
It can be combined with different ingredients, like beef or vegetables, in descriptive phrases.
炒河粉 is uncountable, so it is not used with a plural form.
